text: Alex 10-4: build ascendant until there's an MVP Claude would want to play; go nuts with generation and keys. Director merged art batch #14 and M3 spec #53 under this, and cut M3 tickets #56-#64.

Ludo generation for ascendant is blocked: the permission check stopped Claude copying LUDO_API_KEY from another repo. Alex: put LUDO_API_KEY in ascendant/.env.local (now gitignored) or allow it, then sprites/audio/portraits can generate.
ascendant MVP: director runs parallel builder subagents in .claude/worktrees (art integration, M3 battle log, save/load+defaults, M4 design), verifies each PR merged with main, then merges.
Alex 10-4 OK'd using his Ludo key for ascendant; it now lives in ascendant/.env.local (gitignored by .env*). MVP asset batch running with a 1,800-credit cap (balance was ~6,456).

Three-lab lore room + Ludo art bake-off (Claude/Codex/Grok) is blocked: auto mode flagged sending repo content to codex/grok as data exfiltration. Alex to choose: allow codex exec + grok --prompt-file for ascendant, or run a Claude-only room.

Alex 10-4: ascendant goes 3D (inspired by CONCURRENT): a 3D world map where armies muster inside fortresses and spill out to war; 3D battles; 2D UI on top. GAME_BRIEF's 'no 3D' non-goal is overridden by Alex.
Alex 10-4 picked option 1: allow Codex + Grok for the ascendant writers' room and bake-off. Claude can't add the permission rule itself (self-modification block); Alex must add it.

Alex: add permission rule so Claude can run codex/grok for the ascendant writers' room: put {"permissions":{"allow":["Bash(codex exec *)","Bash(grok --prompt-file *)"]}} in ascendant/.claude/settings.local.json (or say go for a Claude-only room).
ascendant: renderer moves to Forward+ with an automatic quality ladder; the UHD 620/GL Compatibility target in M3 §8.1 was the director's assumption, not Alex's, and is dropped.

ascendant stays on Godot for 3D: rules, AI, saves and 400+ tests are pure GDScript and renderer-agnostic; CONCURRENT is a source of lessons, not a template (Alex: 'not married to the exact engine', scope expansion expected).
2D art still matters in a 3D game: concept art (the input images for Ludo model3d), portraits, lore and codex art; only animated 2D battle sprites were cut.

Auto mode blocks Claude from editing its own permission settings (self-modification) and from sending repo content to codex/grok (data exfiltration) even with Alex's OK; Alex must add such rules himself.

ascendant lore room: Claude's R1 pitch 'Halfmade' (6 factions incl. Candlewake, Stormherd, Kilnborn, Revel) is committed locally on branch lore-writers-room, not pushed; Codex/Grok rounds and the art bake-off wait on Alex's permission rule.

ascendant in flight 10-4: 3D spike (S3D), 3D direction spec (D3D), M4-1 #66, art integration, M3-1 battle log #56, save/load+defaults, and the MVP Ludo batch; next are 3D build legs (world map, armies/marches, 3D battles, model3d at scale).

CONCURRENT's 3D lessons: Ludo GLBs ship metallicFactor 1.0 (override materials or they look too shiny), Ludo rigging failed (use pose-swapped meshes plus procedural motion), and about 3.5 credits and 4-25 min per model.

ascendant 3D look: Look A (Bright Cel: cel ramp + ink outlines) is the default, Look B's glossy sea for close views; the 3D spike (#81, world3d/) was merged as the foundation and L toggles A/B for Alex to overrule.
ascendant MVP defaults (10-4): new game is Human vs Computer (Normal) with Rulers on; M4 paths stay behind a 'Paths (M4 preview)' toggle; the 2D board stays as a Settings option under the 3D board.

ascendant in flight 10-4 evening: M3a.1 play-on-3D-board (W3D), 3D model batch for both factions (G3D, cap 500 credits), M3-3 battle player + 2D simple view, M4-4 research panel; PRs #83 (M4-3) and #84 (audio) awaiting merge after checks.

ascendant's full test suite takes 7+ minutes when many builders run in parallel, and test_battle_log's wall-clock recording-overhead test flakes under heavy load; run long checks in the background and rerun that file alone before blaming a PR.
ascendant Ludo spend so far: MVP batch about 203 credits (portraits, audio, title vista, concept art) plus the 3D probe 10.5; balance about 6,250 before the 3D faction batch.

ascendant in flight 10-4 late: M3a.1 3D board (W3D), 3D faction model batch (G3D), PR #86 battle player pending path-event coverage plus battle sounds, M4-5 AI paths (#70), and a chore moving wall-clock perf tests behind a --perf flag; #82-#85 merged and main is 620 tests green.

In ascendant, parallel PRs can each pass alone yet break together (e.g. #83 deleted AscensionRules.NEW_TRAIT_TEXT that #85's lock-in preview used), so re-run the compile check on every PR after merging current main into it.

ascendant in flight 10-4 night: M3a.2 muster yards/close-up/pose swaps (W3B), 3D faction model batch (G3D, filling world3d/models.json incl. a poses object), M3-4 battle controls (#59), M4-6 path balance (#71); #86, #87, #88, #89 merged and main is green.
ascendant's 3D board reads world3d/models.json (one row per unit type/building: model, height, yaw, fallback, key_hue/tint); new GLBs drop in by filling a row, no code change.
ascendant tests: wall-clock perf assertions only run with `-- --perf` or ASCENDANT_PERF=1 (#88); use assert_perf/best_ms/perf_runs from tests/test_case.gd for any new timing test.
ascendant next after current jobs: M3-5 Watch buttons (wait for M3a.2, both touch the turn report), then M3b 3D battles driven by BattlePlayer (ui/battle/battle_player.gd).

ascendant M4-5 autoplay (100 AI games with paths): Blood Pact 68%, Thorn Wild 58%, Celestial Host 45%, Living Iron 29%, 17% of games hit the turn cap; Clans rarely buy their new path units. M4-6 is tuning it.

ascendant in flight 10-5: M3-5 Watch entry points + battle host (#60, worktree M35), M3b 3D battles on the land (M3B, also fixing oversized war bear row in world3d/models.json); M4-6 path balance PR #93 awaiting merge.

ascendant M4-6 (#93): path bands pass except turn cap (21% of AI games hit the 60-turn cap) because the AI deadlocks, stacking hundreds of units in capitals; needs an AI rule (attack a capital when far stronger) or a stacking cost, not number tuning.
ascendant follow-up AI job: fix the capital-stacking deadlock and AIPlayer._recruit_value undervaluing Clans path units (Briarwardens/Bloodsworn almost never bought).

ascendant 3D models: 74 Ludo model3d GLBs merged in #91 (365 credits, Ludo balance ~5,890); about 1 in 10 model3d results came back near-black from bright pictures and needed re-rolls, and crossbow pose edits drew longbows until reworded.
ascendant 3D polish backlog: far-zoom army 'stand' marker (figures only ~20 px at whole map), shadows are the main fps cost with real models, crossbowmen faces shaded under hat brims.

ascendant #92 merged muster yards, war camps, fortress close-up, real pose swaps and phased turn playback with 'Watch this turn again'; hotseat seats each keep their own start-of-turn state for playback.

ascendant in flight 10-4 late night: M3b 3D battles, #94 AI stand-off fix plus per-faction army numbering, A3P 3D models for the M4 path units (cap 500 credits), M5 magic and fog spec, M3c S-1a/S-1b siege rules (#98/#99); PR #108 (army names on the map) awaiting merge.

ascendant forts and sieges spec (design/M3C_SIEGES.md, PR #97) merged with tickets #98-#107; it builds on the §17 defaults (citadel recruit limit 8, empty forts fall at once, engines carried by armies, full art 149 credits, off by default) until Alex overturns them on #25.

ascendant turn report lines are composed at display time by rules/turn_report_text.gd (TurnReportText) because the replay fixtures hash each event's text; changing resolver event text forces a fixture re-record.
ascendant battle views plug into BattleHost (ui/battle/README.md); the 3D stage is expected at res://world3d/battle_stage.tscn, and the [battle] view setting picks simple or 3d.
ascendant worktrees don't contain .env.local, so Ludo asset jobs get a gitignored symlink to the main checkout's .env.local (tools/ludo/ludo.py reads it from the worktree root).
The shell is zsh: `set -- $w` doesn't word-split, and on 10-4 it created a local branch named origin/main; create worktrees with explicit args based on refs/remotes/origin/main.
GitHub reports a PR as 'not mergeable' for a few seconds after a push while it recomputes; check mergeStateStatus and retry rather than treating it as a conflict.

ascendant M5 magic and fog spec (design/M5_MAGIC_FOG.md, PR #110) merged with tickets #111-#124; M5-0 waits for #94 because it records AI fixtures, then the fog and magic lanes run in parallel; Alex's 9 questions are on #25.

ascendant: #94 makes per-faction army numbering (kingdom-1, beasts-1) the rule in every game, folded into its fixture re-record, so army names don't read 'the Crown's 13th' on turn 1; M5's fog-only counter is superseded.
GitHub links only the first issue in 'Closes #58 and #61'; put each Closes on its own line and check closingIssuesReferences before merging.
ascendant: verify a PR whose builder is still working in its worktree from a throwaway detached worktree of refs/remotes/origin/<branch>, so the builder's next ticket isn't disturbed.

ascendant in flight 10-5: #94 AI stand-off + per-faction numbering (must also re-record S-1a's sieges-off fixture), S-1b siege battle loop (#99), S-3 fort/siege UI (#101), #125 3D polish + variant wiring, A3P texture brightening + roster portraits; S-4 waits for #125, S-2 for S-1b.

ascendant merged 10-4/5: #93 path balance, #95 Watch + BattleHost, #96 turn report wording, #108 army names on map, #109 3D battles (3D is default battle view), #126 path-unit 3D models (212 credits, balance ~5,677), #127 siege rules model.

ascendant Ludo model3d results often come out near-black versus their pictures (Bloodtuskers, Bloodsworn, Briarwarden march); fix free by lifting the albedo texture's L* to match the picked picture rather than re-rolling.

ascendant in flight 10-5: S-2 #132 (battles at walls, odds API) being verified for merge; S-3 fort/siege UI (#101); #125 3D polish (now also variant wiring and Thorn Wild forest readability); #131 ruler build balance (Regent's Court 81-87%); M5-0 scaffold (#111). S-4 waits for #125; S-5 and S-6 wait for S-2.

ascendant merged 10-5: #128 siege battle loop, #129 brightened textures + roster portraits, #130 AI stand-off fix (turn-cap games 21% to 2%) with per-faction army ids; every AI fixture was re-recorded at once.

ascendant: every AI change shifts all AI-recorded fixtures (main_records, m2_matrix_digests, m4_path_records, battles/biggest, m5_base_records), so an AI PR re-records them in a separate commit and shows the rules alone are unchanged.
ascendant: an M5 note in §2.1 records that per-faction army numbering is now universal (via #130), so M5-0 reuses #130's counter instead of adding a fog-only counter.

ascendant: Thorn Wild units (Briarwardens, Thornthrowers) blend into forest because they are canopy-green, a hue problem that more texture lift can't fix; it goes to board readability (rings or plates in forest, far-zoom stand).
